outcome: Abnormal foetal head position at delivery
cohort: 23,183 women with term, singleton, vaginal deliveries (including spontaneous and induced labours) at a single institution from January 2004 to June 2016
finding: Epidural analgesia was not associated with an increased risk of severe perineal tears, but it was an independent risk factor for instrumental delivery, caesarean section, and abnormal foetal head position at delivery.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia was not associated with an increased risk of severe perineal tears, but it was an independent risk factor for instrumental delivery and caesarean section.
